_about: The UMP45's left hand rests on its idle hand locator, where a grip can move it (docs/notes/attachments-grips.md): its idle, shoot and reload hands clips get the left_hand_ik channel 0.69d0's own clips of the same names have (value 4 the idle locator, 2 the gun's left_hand_cont bone during the reload). In 0.26g the show clip leaves the hand on that bone for good; in the gun's own clips the bone sits on the idle locator (0.3 mm), so the hand without a grip is where it was. Made by scripts/weapon-grips/hand_events.py.
